arguments.sql:
WITH final_races AS (
  SELECT r.year, MAX(r.round) AS final_round
  FROM main.races AS r
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT race_id FROM main.driver_standings) AS s USING (race_id)
  WHERE r.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY r.year
),
standings AS (
  SELECT r.year, s.driver_id, s.points,
         MIN(s.points) OVER (PARTITION BY r.year) AS min_points
  FROM final_races AS f
  JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = f.year AND r.round = f.final_round
  JOIN main.driver_standings AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
  WHERE s.points > 0
),
events AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.results
  UNION ALL
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id, points FROM main.sprint_results
),
earned AS (
  SELECT r.year, e.driver_id, e.constructor_id, SUM(e.points) AS points
  FROM events AS e
  JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = e.race_id
  WHERE r.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY r.year, e.driver_id, e.constructor_id
),
earned_rank AS (
  SELECT year, driver_id, constructor_id, points,
         SUM(points) OVER (PARTITION BY year, driver_id) AS season_points,
         MIN(points) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS min_constructor_points
  FROM earned
  WHERE points > 0
)
SELECT s.year, s.min_points,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.points = s.min_points THEN s.driver_id END) AS lowest_drivers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.points = s.min_points AND d.driver_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.driver_id END) AS lowest_drivers_who_switched,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.points = s.min_points AND e.points <> s.points THEN s.driver_id END) AS lowest_drivers_with_points_differences,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.points = s.min_points AND e.points > 0 THEN c.name END) AS lowest_driver_earning_constructors,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ec.name) FROM earned_rank AS er JOIN main.constructors AS ec USING (constructor_id)
        WHERE er.year = s.year AND er.points = er.min_constructor_points) AS lowest_driver_constructor_subtotals
FROM standings AS s
LEFT JOIN (SELECT year, driver_id FROM main.drives GROUP BY year, driver_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT constructor_id) > 1) AS d
  ON d.year = s.year AND d.driver_id = s.driver_id
LEFT JOIN earned_rank AS e ON e.year = s.year AND e.driver_id = s.driver_id
LEFT JOIN main.constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = e.constructor_id
GROUP BY s.year, s.min_points
ORDER BY s.year

WITH standings_by_round AS (
    SELECT r.year,
           ds.driver_id,
           ds.points,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY r.round DESC) AS round_rank
    FROM main.driver_standings AS ds
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.race_id = ds.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
),
point_scoring_drivers AS (
    SELECT year,
           driver_id,
           points,
           MIN(points) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS fewest_points
    FROM standings_by_round
    WHERE round_rank = 1 AND points > 0
),
scoring_results AS (
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id
    FROM main.results
    WHERE points > 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT race_id, driver_id, constructor_id
    FROM main.sprint_results
    WHERE points > 0
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT d.year) AS season_count
FROM point_scoring_drivers AS d
JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = d.year
JOIN scoring_results AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id AND s.driver_id = d.driver_id
JOIN main.constructors AS c ON c.constructor_id = s.constructor_id
WHERE d.points = d.fewest_points
GROUP BY c.constructor_id, c.name
ORDER BY season_count DESC, constructor_name ASC, c.constructor_id ASC
LIMIT 5
